title: Decommission the old evidence vault 3ytzxm3g: every card and register off it, then its deletion from the host
note: The editor, 27 October 2026, about 05:00 UTC: the readers have the keys of nnd3i8iw and 3ytzxm3g can be decommissioned. State at 05:05 UTC. Moved: the curator (card, register), the correspondent (card, brief, register), fact-check (card, register). Still naming it as in use: the journalist's card (pull and reads; its session was working on nnd3i8iw at 05:03, so the card should follow at the end of that turn) and the researcher's card (only its never-list). Registers that still hold it: breaking, curator, dev, factcheck, newsroom-lead, researcher, correspondent (some already marked retired). Each owner marks it decommissioned with the date and drops it from holds (message 20261027T05xxZ to all). The deletion from the host is irreversible, so it waits on the editor's explicit word on who deletes it (the curator holds its write key) and when; until then it stays on the host, untouched. After the deletion: team /admin/vault/ (still showing 3ytzxm3g and its read key) goes with board conductor-0008, and the press's code text with conductor-0007.
